title: Anatomy of a Paradigm Shift: Why the Transformer Architecture Definitively Scaled NLP
hook: Opening with the computational bottleneck of sequential recurrence, the introduction immediately frames the Transformer as a structural bypass that enabled unbounded parallelization and global context capture.

sections.heading: The Recurrence Bottleneck: Sequential Limits in LSTMs and RNNs
key_points: Inherent sequential dependency in recurrent architectures prevents parallelization during training
Vanishing and exploding gradients across long sequences degrade performance on long-range dependencies
Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT) creates massive memory footprints for extended contexts

sections.heading: Mathematical Formulation of Scaled Dot-Product Attention
key_points: Projection of input embeddings into Query (Q), Key (K), and Value (V) subspaces
Scaling factor by the inverse square root of the key dimension to prevent gradient saturation in the softmax function
Computation of global context through matrix multiplication yielding $O(N^2)$ sequence length complexity

sections.heading: Multi-Head Subspaces and Positional Encoding Mechanics
key_points: Splitting projections into multiple heads allows simultaneous attention to different representation subspaces
Sinusoidal and learned absolute positional encodings inject token order into permutation-invariant operations
Linear projection layers combine multi-head outputs to preserve dimensional consistency

sections.heading: Unlocking Hardware Acceleration and Foundation Model Scaling Laws
key_points: Matrix multiplication heavy operations map efficiently onto GPU Tensor Cores for massive speedups
Removal of recurrent bottlenecks enables unsupervised pre-training on colossal web-scale corpora
Predictable scaling laws govern the power-law relationship between compute, data size, and cross-entropy loss

conclusion_point: By replacing recurrence with parallelizable self-attention, the Transformer transformed NLP from a feature-engineering bottleneck into a hardware-scalable empirical science.
topic: Why the Transformer architecture changed NLP
